KOVA connects verified Boilermakers to shared rides — airport runs, Indy games, Chicago weekends, concerts, career trips, and everyday errands. Cheaper, safer, more human.

The Problem

Transportation is access.
And access is unequal.

Without a car, students regularly say no — to experiences, connections, and opportunities that shape college life.

When transportation is expensive, inconsistent, or isolating — "no" becomes the default.

KOVA Research, 2024
  • ✈️ Airport TripsInternational students stranded over breaks with no affordable way home.
  • 🎵 Events & ConcertsTickets bought, rides not. Plans cancelled at the last minute.
  • 💼 Career MomentsCompany visits, networking events, and fairs missed because no one had a car.
  • 🛒 Everyday NeedsGroceries, errands, pharmacies — too far to walk, too expensive on rideshare.
